concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-capital-make-grant-request]] — 2026-09-15 Capital POST /grants and disbursement-update guide for offer/ToS/capability gates, recipient selection, asynchronous Requested response and separate grant/transfer/transaction evidence.
warnings: Requested response and grants.created sample (itself still Requested/zero-balance) do not prove funding; transfer received/authorised/booked and transaction.created observations are distinct.

The test transaction illustration has negative amount and 2023 booking/creation dates while incoming positive transfer illustrations are dated 2025; do not present them as one coherent payout or infer universal sign/date mapping.
Balance-account/default-primary and transfer-instrument recipient descriptions must remain distinct; the page does not prove an external bank's receipt.
